dream_synopsis: Embry dreams of an internship room that behaves like a diagnostic bench: boxes, tools, family anchors, and propulsion hardware rearrange themselves into one portable system. Tommy’s calm procedural language threads through the dream, turning shutdown, safety, and home-making into the same act of trust without requiring Embry to confess the vulnerable source beneath it.

panels.action: Embry holds a phone and describes an intermittent fault while the bad logs on the desk flicker into a reflection of her own face; Tommy asks, without alarm, whether she has eaten and whether the system is her.
panels.setting: A dim internship-housing room half-filled with boxes, with an OPEN FIRST box open beside a desk that also resembles a technical workbench.
panels.shot: Foreground close-up of Embry Lawson facing camera, her expression tired but controlled; Tommy Lawson appears behind her as a calm figure on a glowing phone screen.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry’s face is clearly visible in the foreground, lit by the phone; behind her, cardboard boxes, a folded family afghan, and scattered diagnostic printouts blur together.

panels.action: Embry places each tool into its drawn outline, then notices one wrench-shaped blank space; without turning independence into silence, she reports the missing wrench to Tommy while the cabinet note glows warmly behind her.
panels.setting: The same room transforms into a portable home: the afghan spreads over a chair, a chess-pie phone note is taped inside a cabinet, and hand tools are outlined on paper across the wall.
panels.shot: Medium shot with Embry in the foreground, face visible as she looks down in concentration; Tommy Lawson stands at the edge of the room like a patient garage instructor, partially framed by hanging tools.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry’s face is visible in three-quarter view in the foreground; the afghan, taped note, and tool outlines form a precise domestic constellation behind her, with Tommy watching quietly.

panels.action: Someone’s joke about being close enough ripples through the air like static; Embry calls hold, resets the angle, and rubs the pale line near her face while explaining only the geometry, not the memory attached to the scar.
panels.setting: A propulsion-club launch area fused with the internship room, where a countdown board hangs above boxed clothes and a loose guide tube points at an unsafe angle.
panels.shot: Tight foreground shot of Embry’s face visible beside a slanted guide tube; Tommy Lawson appears in the background as a steady, out-of-focus presence near a car-door-shaped shadow.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry’s face fills the foreground, jaw set and eyes fixed on the guide tube; the pale scar near her face catches the light as the launch hardware tilts wrong behind her.

panels.action: Tommy tells her to label the current state, shut down, and sleep before touching the problem again; Embry closes the logbook, leaves the missing-wrench outline visible, and accepts rest as competent procedure rather than failure.
panels.setting: The dream-room settles into a hybrid of bedroom, workbench, and safe launch bay: tools labeled, afghan in place, note taped up, guide tube corrected, and logs neatly marked current state.
panels.shot: Front-facing medium close-up of Embry in the foreground, face clearly visible as she exhales; Tommy Lawson is visible behind her on the phone screen and as a soft reflection in the darkened window.
panels.start_frame_description: Embry faces forward in the foreground with the phone in one hand and a labeled logbook in the other; Tommy’s calm image glows behind her while the room’s anchors hold steady.
